description:
Replace the private image-building helpers in the export, initialization and profile-application test modules with the shared test image builder.

## Background

- `jit::test_harness` offers a builder that closes a `RepositoryImage` over any declared entries, listings and pinned evidence, with a derived or caller-supplied capture spec and layout.
- Private closers in these test modules:
  - `crates/jit/src/repository_state/export.rs`: `layout` and `image` (`:311-340`), over directory and symlink entries and the spec `RepositoryExportIntent::capture_spec` produces, and the inline close at `:471`;
  - `repository_state/initialize.rs`: `image_with_records` (`:1305-1328`), over directory entries;
  - `repository_state/profile_apply.rs`: `image_owning` (`:3385`), `image_with_profile_owner` (`:3506`) and the inline closes at `:4466,4624`, over directory entries.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The listed test modules build images through the shared builder, and none of them closes a `RepositoryImage` through a helper or inline call of its own.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each rewritten test asserts the property it asserted before, and the repository-state suites pass.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Export, initialization and profile test images use the shared builder
